# readable_path { #crossrepo.cache.readable_path }

```python
crossrepo.cache.readable_path(repo_key, version, path, root=None)
```

Location of the readable hard link for a cached object.

The whole repository-relative path is kept, not just the file name, because
a file name is not unique within a repository. Two directories may hold
files of the same name that last changed in the same commit, which gives
them one version key, and naming the links by file name alone would then
point both at whichever was fetched first.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**repo_key**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository identifier, as `crossrepo.model.Entry.repo_key`.

<code>[**version**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Abbreviated commit sha of the version.

<code>[**path**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository-relative path to expose the content under, for example ``results/sub/stable.csv``.

<code>[**root**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[Path](`pathlib.Path`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Cache root. Defaults to [](`crossrepo.config.cache_root`).

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Path](`pathlib.Path`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Path of the link, whether or not it exists.
